headline: If I reply, Jev decides what I meant:

media.alt: Image from the post by emir yorulmaz

text:
I'm getting crazy results with @typesafeai's Jev.

The flow in Altair: I say "I had two eggs and toast" and a card pops up: "Two eggs and toast, about 220 calories." If I say nothing, it saves itself after 5 seconds. If I reply, Jev decides what I meant:

"Sure, save it" → saved…
